about_the_game:
Developer Support Package

Every decision you make matters. By supporting our developers, you contribute to the creation of the Naviiki game world, exciting stories and unique game mechanics. Your choice is not just a purchase, it is an investment in the future of the game that we are creating together.

What is included in the package?

A token to exchange in-game in a specialized store for in-game currency (credits), which you can exchange in the "Item Shop" for various items: Skins, Boosters, Charms, Cases, or a Premium subscription.

1.Exclusive Content

- Alternative skins for your character: Give your character or "Gear" a unique look with an exclusive appearance, available only to the owners of a package with a Purple token or a Red one.

2. Bonuses for players

- A set of cosmetic items: Customize your character's appearance with unique accessories and skins available in any support package.

- Accelerating progress: Get your token among the first! And exchange it in the game for credits in the "Item Shop" and choose any available item to develop your hero faster and explore the game world.

3.Team support

- Direct access to developers: Participate in private polls and votes, influence the development of the game and share your ideas with the team, having a special role in our Discord when purchasing any support package.

4. Why should you support us?

Your participation helps us to continue creating high-quality content in the game and improve the existing world. We strive to make every player feel like a part of our community, and your contribution plays a key role in achieving this goal.

5. The future of our project

We believe that by working together we can create something truly great. Your every vote is important, every idea is valuable. Together we are building a future where games become even more interesting, deeper and more diverse.

Join our community and become a part of the story!

6.FAQ

Question: What exactly will I get by purchasing the package?

Answer: You will receive an exclusive game token (digital bonus), which includes the possibility to exchange it for game credits. Cosmetic items for your character and items that affect the acceleration of progress. You will also be given direct access to the developers and the opportunity to influence the development of the game.

Question: How long will the bonuses last?

Answer: The bonuses are valid indefinitely. All the items and features you receive will stay with you forever until you decide to spend your token.You can buy any number of tokens of different colors. The tokens themselves have their own fixed price, which is not subject to any inflation.

Question: Can I get a refund if I change my mind?

Answer: Yes, according to the Steam refund policy, you can refund the funds within a certain period after purchase. Check the details on the Steam website.

Question: Which platforms are supported?

Answer: The package is available for all platforms on which the game is distributed via Steam.

Buy now and become a part of our history!

Together we are creating a future where games are getting better every day. Join our community and help us make the game even brighter and more exciting!

Note: After making the purchase, contact Discord with the receipt via the user support form (ticket) to receive further instructions.
